provenance.generator: Python random.Random(seed).random(), one call for every lexicographic unordered a<b pair; edge iff draw<p. Seeds are 202610300000+n*1000+sample_index. Same seed at different densities produces nested graphs.

methodology: One fresh-process timing per build on each distinct graph, with the same input file used for both. 10 before-first and 10 after-first graphs per 20-sample group. Graphs are shuffled deterministically; 3 worker processes run on distinct pinned physical cores, each completing its reference check and paired application runs sequentially. Other workers share machine resources. No per-graph warmup or within-graph repetitions. Wall time includes launch, parsing, analysis, output, cleanup, and limit setup. Reference generation and checking are outside each application timing. Successful outputs must agree with the independent reference and completed pairs must have byte-identical CSV. Timeouts remain censored: they are not successful outputs, negative CFS results, or observed completion times. Group quantiles use linear interpolation at (N-1)q, with intervals for right-censored observations. Complete-pair speedup statistics exclude censored pairs and may be selection-biased. Source/binary hashes and exact deterministic input hashes are retained. No claim of exclusive physical host access is made.
